parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Part one.

You will hear a telephone conversation between a man who wants to book some accommodation at a holiday park and a woman who works at the park.

1st, you have some time to look at questions one to 5.

Now listen carefully and answer questions one to 5.

Good morning. Ahopi Holiday Park.

Oh, hello. We're planning on coming to Ahopi for a couple of weeks during the summer holidays, and some friends of mine recommended your holiday park, particularly the wooden cabins you have.

That's good to hear. Well, we have different types of cabin available.

Can you tell me about the most basic type?

Yes. We have a couple of cabins still available which are right beside the pool.

That sounds great.

Yes, they are in a good spot. They have one main living area, and there's another room with the beds. If you want to do any cooking, there's a communal kitchen that everyone uses. But otherwise, the kitchen in the cabin just has a fridge, a small one, and also a microwave for heating things up.

I see. And what's the cost of that?

That's 35 dollars per night.

Okay. And what other types of cabin do you have?

Right. We have our standard cabins. These are near reception, so that's handy if you want to come in and get us to book a trip or anything. The kitchen is fully equipped, too, so you can do all your cooking there.

What other facilities does it have? Is there a television?

In the standard cabin, I'm afraid not. But it has a shower, which you don't get in the basic cabin.

Okay.

And that's 55 dollars a night inclusive.

And is there another cabin type?

Yes, the standard plus.

All of these cabins are directly opposite the lake, and they all come with a private spa as well.

Sounds good.

I should tell you that these cabins are quite popular, so I'd advise you to book as soon as possible.

I don't suppose there's a discount for booking for a longer period?

There is, actually, for the standard plus. Once you go up to 5 nights, there's a 15 percent discount, and anything more than 10 nights, it's 18 percent.

I'll give it some thought. I think we'll probably go for the standard.

All right.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions 6 to 10.

Now listen and answer questions 6 to 10.

So for children, what kind of activities can they do at the holiday park? Do you have a trampoline or anything?

No, but a lot of the kids who come here do tennis. It costs nothing to use our court, and they can come borrow the rackets from us, as long as they bring them back, of course.

Great. My kids would be into that. And we're planning to bring our boat with us and get out on the water. Is it possible for an afternoon or something to hire some equipment? We're hoping to go fishing, but we don't have our own stuff.

Yes, for a small charge, we can let you have some equipment.

Fantastic. Is there anything else for kids to do in the Ahopi area?

Well, on Saturday or Sunday, you might like to go to the farm. It's only a short drive from the holiday park. You can go riding there and see how everything works. It's quite a popular thing to do.

Okay. I'll just make a note of that.

Actually, one thing I would recommend, depending on whether your children don't mind a late night-

I'm sure they wouldn't.

Well, it's a guided tour, 20 dollars for a family, every evening, and you go along with the guide into the forest. That's when the native birds wake up, and it's a great chance to see them in their natural habitat.

My daughter would love that. Now, I just want to check all this with my wife. Will you still be there in 30 minutes?

No, I'm going on my lunch break, but I'll pass your details on to someone else who can confirm your reservation. Her name's Aritaki. That's A-R-A-T-A-K-I.

All right. Thank you.

You're welcome.

That is the end of Part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to Part one.

analyses.content: 录音明确提到木屋内的厨房里只有冰箱（fridge）和用来加热的微波炉（microwave）。
你可能会听到“communal kitchen（公共厨房）”而分心，但题目限定了条件，你只需要抓取木屋内部（in the cabin）包含的具体电器即可。
If you want to do any cooking, there's a communal kitchen that everyone uses. But otherwise, the kitchen in the cabin just has a fridge, a small one, and also a microwave for heating things up.
录音中提到标准木屋（standard cabins）在接待处（reception）附近，完美对应题干的“Close to（靠近）”。
你可能会因为没反应过来“near”就是“Close to”的同义替换而漏听，做题时听到定位词“standard cabins”就要立刻竖起耳朵抓取方位名词。
Right. We have our standard cabins. These are near reception, so that's handy if you want to come in and get us to book a trip or anything.
录音里明确肯定了标准木屋里配有淋浴（shower），这是基础房型没有的设施。
你很可能听到提问中的“television（电视）”就急忙填上，但紧接着的“I'm afraid not（恐怕没有）”直接否定了这个选项，一定要听完整句话的肯定或否定态度。
What other facilities does it have? Is there a television? In the standard cabin, I'm afraid not. But it has a shower, which you don't get in the basic cabin. Okay.
录音提到高级标准木屋（standard plus）直接位于湖（lake）的对面，对应题目的“Facing the（面向...）”。
你可能会对“opposite（在...对面）”和“Facing”的同义替换不敏感，同时要小心不要错填成后面提到的补充设施“spa”。
And is there another cabin type? Yes, the standard plus. All of these cabins are directly opposite the lake, and they all come with a private spa as well. Sounds good.
录音中清晰说明，只要预订超过10晚（more than 10 nights），折扣就是18%（18 percent）。
你极容易听到前面出现的“5 nights”对应的“15 percent”就直接填入，必须耐心听完，将题干条件“over ten nights”与录音对应才能避开干扰。

I don't suppose there's a discount for booking for a longer period? There is, actually, for the standard plus. Once you go up to 5 nights, there's a 15 percent discount, and anything more than 10 nights, it's 18 percent. I'll give it some thought.

groups.contentHtml:
General information about the holiday park and the Ohope area:
•  The children can play for free.
•  It’s possible to hire equipment for for an afternoon.
•  The children could visit the local on Saturday and Sunday.
•  There are guided tours of the every evening to see the birds.
•  Contact to confirm the booking.

analyses.content: 录音确认了孩子们在这里可以打网球（tennis），并且使用场地没有任何花费（costs nothing），对应题目中的“for free”。
你可能想填录音中男士提问时说的蹦床（trampoline），但这被女士立刻用“No”否定了，千万不要盲目抓取第一个听到的名词。

So for children, what kind of activities can they do at the holiday park? Do you have a trampoline or anything? No, but a lot of the kids who come here do tennis. It costs nothing to use our court, and they can come borrow the rackets from us, as long as they bring them back, of course. Great.
男士提到他们想去钓鱼（fishing）所以需要租装备，女士也给予了肯定的答复。
你可能会因为前一句提到的船（boat）而迷惑，但录音明确说船是他们自己带来的（bring our boat），需要租借装备（hire some equipment）是为了去钓鱼。

Is it possible for an afternoon or something to hire some equipment? We're hoping to go fishing, but we don't have our own stuff. Yes, for a small charge, we can let you have some equipment. Fantastic.
录音中给出的建议是，在周六或周日可以去当地的农场（farm）看看。
你如果光听名词，可能会想填后面的骑马（riding），但题干问的是去哪里“visit the local...”，必须填地点名词。

Is there anything else for kids to do in the Ahopi area? Well, on Saturday or Sunday, you might like to go to the farm. It's only a short drive from the holiday park. You can go riding there and see how everything works. It's quite a popular thing to do. Okay.
向导会在每天傍晚带队进入森林（forest），正是为了让大家去看鸟。
你可能会把注意力放在去看什么，从而错填了鸟（birds），但题干问的是去哪里的导览游（guided tours of the...），一定要理清修饰关系。

Well, it's a guided tour, 20 dollars for a family, every evening, and you go along with the guide into the forest. That's when the native birds wake up, and it's a great chance to see them in their natural habitat. My daughter would love that.
女士表示自己要去午休，会将信息转交给一位名叫Arataki（录音拼写为A-R-A-T-A-K-I）的同事来确认预订。
这是纯粹的拼写题，你容易在听写字母时把A和E、R和I搞混，只要按着字母发音一个一个精准写下即可稳拿分数。
No, I'm going on my lunch break, but I'll pass your details on to someone else who can confirm your reservation. Her name's Aritaki. That's A-R-A-T-A-K-I. All right.
